legend: A sweet little monster Om Nom loves candies very much. One day he found himself in a rather tricky situation that required him to think a bit in order to enjoy candies the most. Would you succeed with the same task if you were on his place?

One day, when he came to his friend Evan, Om Nom didn't find him at home but he found two bags with candies. The first was full of blue candies and the second bag was full of red candies. Om Nom knows that each red candy weighs Wr grams and each blue candy weighs Wb grams. Eating a single red candy gives Om Nom Hr joy units and eating a single blue candy gives Om Nom Hb joy units.

Candies are the most important thing in the world, but on the other hand overeating is not good. Om Nom knows if he eats more than C grams of candies, he will get sick. Om Nom thinks that it isn't proper to leave candy leftovers, so he can only eat a whole candy. Om Nom is a great mathematician and he quickly determined how many candies of what type he should eat in order to get the maximum number of joy units. Can you repeat his achievement? You can assume that each bag contains more candies that Om Nom can eat.
input: The single line contains five integers C, Hr, Hb, Wr, Wb (1 ≤ C, Hr, Hb, Wr, Wb ≤ 109).
output: Print a single integer — the maximum number of joy units that Om Nom can get.
note: In the sample test Om Nom can eat two candies of each type and thus get 16 joy units.

legend.ai: 一只可爱的小怪物 Om Nom 非常喜欢糖果。一天，他发现自己陷入了一个相当棘手的情况，需要稍微思考一下，才能尽可能享用更多糖果。如果你处于和他相同的境地，你能完成同样的任务吗？
一天，Om Nom 来到他的朋友 Evan 家时，没有发现 Evan 在家，但找到了两袋糖果。第一袋装满了蓝色糖果，第二袋装满了红色糖果。Om Nom 知道，每颗红色糖果的重量为 Wr 克，每颗蓝色糖果的重量为 Wb 克。吃一颗红色糖果可以让 Om Nom 获得 Hr 点快乐值，吃一颗蓝色糖果可以让 Om Nom 获得 Hb 点快乐值。
糖果是世界上最重要的东西，但另一方面，吃得过多也不好。Om Nom 知道，如果他吃下的糖果重量超过 C 克，就会生病。Om Nom 认为留下糖果残渣是不合适的，因此他只能吃完整的糖果。Om Nom 是一位出色的数学家，很快就确定了应该吃多少颗、什么类型的糖果，才能获得最大的快乐值。你能重复他的成就吗？可以假设每袋糖果中包含的糖果数量都多于 Om Nom 能吃的数量。

input.ai: 一行包含五个整数 C、Hr、Hb、Wr、Wb（1 ≤ C、Hr、Hb、Wr、Wb ≤ 10^9）。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即 Om Nom 能获得的最大快乐值。

note.ai: 在输入样例中，Om Nom 可以吃掉每种类型的两颗糖果，从而获得 16 点快乐值。
